purpose: Design spec for the four forge wrapper SKILLs (query/update for rules and specs) that delegate document search and index maintenance to external backends: skill list, arguments, output contract, SKILL contract.
summary: Overview: forge delegates document search and index updates to backends doc-link and doc-db via four wrapper SKILLs
Skill list: query-db-rules, query-db-specs, update-db-rules, update-db-specs with fixed category and user-invocable true
Query flow: resolve backend order, run first available backend, no index maintenance, delegate to update with approval
Query output contract: Required documents path list built by script, common across backends
Query SKILL contract: inherited-type search SKILL, no context fork, allowed-tools without Grep, args limited to keywords
Update flow: explicit backend option skips selection, otherwise ordered availability check, then backend-specific update path
Desired-state semantics: .doc_structure.yaml is the source of truth; paths not included are removed from the index
Prerequisites: at least one backend available, judged by capability rather than version
Test and lint inventory covering path resolution, query wiring, link contract, and index maintenance boundary
tasks: Modifying query-db or update-db wrapper SKILLs
Designing or changing backend selection and fallback behavior
Reviewing SKILL contracts and allowed-tools for search SKILLs
Updating index maintenance flow and desired-state handling
Adding or changing tests and lint for document search wrappers
Calling query-db skills from other forge SKILLs
title: DES-001 文書検索ラッパー（forge → 文書検索 backend）設計書
